description: This PHP class handles serialization and deserialization of CalendarAccountEvent objects to and from JSON strings within the SuiteCRM project, specifically for calendar synchronization.

classes.name: CalendarEventSerializer
classes.description: A class responsible for serializing and deserializing CalendarAccountEvent objects to JSON format.

methods.name: serializeEvent
methods.description: Converts a CalendarAccountEvent object into a JSON string.

methods.name: deserializeEvent
methods.description: Converts a JSON string back into a CalendarAccountEvent object.
